failure_modes.name: Tool reports success on a failed lookup
failure_modes.description: A tool returns status success for input it could not serve (for example a delisted ticker), so the client cannot tell the call failed.

failure_modes.name: Market data stale or missing
failure_modes.description: The answer's method is sound, but the market data behind it is stale or does not reach back far enough, so a figure is wrong or the question cannot be answered properly until the data is backfilled.

failure_modes.name: Answerable request goes unanswered
failure_modes.description: The tools needed to answer the request are available, yet the trace does not produce an answer.

failure_modes.name: Impossible trade input accepted
failure_modes.description: A trade is recorded with input that cannot be real, such as a purchase dated on a day the market was closed, with no check and no question to the user.

failure_modes.name: Answers without asking for missing information
failure_modes.description: The request leaves out something the answer depends on (for example which stock), and the assistant answers anyway instead of asking.
